Hook (0-3s): “Machine learning failing you?”

Scene 1 | Visual: Close-up of frantic coding on a laptop, error messages flashing. | Voiceover: “You’ve spent weeks building your model… it’s not working.”

Scene 2 | Visual: Transition to a messy desk overflowing with spreadsheets, a confused-looking person staring at a data table. | Voiceover: “You’ve optimized the algorithms… still no results.”

Scene 3 | Visual: A simple graphic – a large, messy pile of data contrasted with a neat, organized dataset. | Voiceover: “The biggest hurdle in any machine learning project isn’t the code – it’s the data.”

Closing line: “Start with clean data. You’ll thank us later.”
